methodology: Daily adaptation of your Overextension Universal Pine script. Distances from EMA20, EMA50 and EMA200 carry 10%, 15% and 50% of the score; extension outside 20-day Bollinger bands (two population standard deviations) carries 25%. Each input is ranked against its own last 500 readings, including ties and the current reading. The sign comes only from price being above or below EMA200. Thresholds are +99 and −97. A new threshold event requires the unsigned score to cross strictly above 99 or 97, then checks direction, as the script does. We require 699 uninterrupted closes instead of using its 50-point startup fallback. Missing closes restart the calculation. Scores describe unusual extension, not reversal probabilities. Values can differ from TradingView with different price adjustments or history; bar-for-bar TradingView parity has not been verified. Extreme streaks count consecutive trading sessions at or above +99, or at or below −97. Historical averages and medians use completed streaks on the same side across the full available calculation history, not just the chart window. An ongoing streak is excluded. Streaks whose start or end is hidden by missing readings are excluded too; a current streak with an unobserved start is shown as a minimum length.
